## UniBo teaching

### SICSS Bologna

**Teaching Assistant, 2022 and 2024** — Summer Institute in Computational Social Science, University of Bologna.

### CyberMondays

**Methods Instructor** — computational social science seminar series.

### Topics taught

- reproducible research with Git and GitHub (version-control concepts, authentication, branching, and merge conflicts);
- accessing research data through APIs (request methods, authentication, data formats, rate limits, and platform governance);
- text-as-data workflows (topic modeling, including LDA and Structural Topic Modeling, topic-model selection and validation using coherence, exclusivity, and human-centred checks, keyword-assisted topic modeling and the place of newer approaches such as BERTopic);
- data provenance, measurement quality, platform-induced bias, and reproducible documentation.

## Data-quality training

I participated in the first cohort of the *KODAQS Data Quality Academy Certificate Program (2024-2025)* <https://www.gesis.org/en/gesis-training/kodaqs-academy/kodaqs-data-quality-academy-certificate-program>. Its train-the-trainer orientation supports the goal of integrating data provenance, access conditions, measurement error, linkage quality, representativeness, and platform bias directly into computational methods teaching.
